title: Chapter 222 The Generals’ Platform
content:
Chapter 222 The Generals’ Platform

I was only ranked fifth.

It's like getting first place in the class, but only ranking in the top ten in the grade.

Wang Shuo couldn't help feeling a little disappointed, and the sense of superiority he had just felt complacent was gone!

The four villages in front are quite powerful!

There are always people who are better than you.

"Why don't you publish the names of the lords in the ranking of Hedong County? I really want to know who the head of Dongshi Village is! \\(^o^)/~"

"It seems that if you want to be the first lady, you still have to go to Dongshi Village. Does anyone know where Dongshi Village is?"

"Upstairs, I advise you to give up this idea. Dongshi Village is not in Changping County. How do you get there? Do you walk?"

The focus of the discussion in the group suddenly turned to Dongshi Village, and Wang Shuo felt a little jealous!

Was he abandoned?

[Rewards are being distributed now. 】

…

[Congratulations on getting the first place in the comprehensive strength ranking of Changping County, rewards: reputation +2000, legion order +1, special prop "Commander Platform" +1, 100 Flame War Horse Stallions, "Manual of Command" +1. 】

Wang Shuo saw that these were all war props, and he couldn't help but sigh in his heart, Lord Zach, how warlike is he, this is simply naked encouragement of war!

[Congratulations on getting the fifth place in the comprehensive strength ranking of Hedong County, rewards: reputation +3000, village building order level +1, a saltpeter mine, and a second-level gold mine. 】

When Wang Shuo saw the rewards given by the ranking of Hedong County, he was not happy, but a little worried.

Presumably, the reward for the first place must be much better than his own.

For a while, Wang Shuo beat his chest and stamped his feet, as if he had missed five million.

After a pause, Wang Shuo smiled foolishly again: "I am really greedy!"

"It's good to get the reward, but I still want to compete with others. I am really a little arrogant!"

Only when you get the first place in a county will you be rewarded with a legion order.

It seems that there are not many lords who can form a complete army now.

And he has a more advanced tiger talisman, so he still has an advantage.

[Pointing platform: You can add the names of generals or military advisors to the point-pointing platform to improve the ability of generals or military advisors. 】

This thing is good, Wang Shuo plans to give it a try.

He came to the central square.

The big pit in the middle has been made into a small fountain pool by Suo Yong.

The square suddenly became lively.

Wang Shuo came to the north of the square and placed the point-pointing platform here.

A two-story platform with a length and width of more than ten meters appeared on the spot.

Wang Shuo walked up to the highest level and immediately felt the heroic spirit.

Wang Shuo called the four generals of Wana Village to the second-level platform.

Carve their names on it.

A golden light flashed across the bodies of several people, as if they were blessed by some mysterious power.

[The comprehensive ability of those blessed by the Dianjiangtai is increased by 20%, and 4/10 people can join at present. ]

Only 10 people can be added, which makes Wang Shuo cautious.

["Command Manual": Soldiers observe for a long time and have a chance to open the command attribute. ]

This "Command Manual" is tailor-made for the training of low-level officers.

With "Zhengyang Jin" and "Command Manual", Wang Shuo no longer has to worry about not having enough low-level officers.

He immediately came to the Transmission Hall and put the two books into the bookshelf on the third floor.

In this way, all soldiers can practice in the Transmission Hall, but without energy crystals, there is no acceleration effect.
